sourceOfTruth.visualSystem: Apple iOS 26 style for current-generation iPhone only; all older iOS 27 and iPad/iPadOS requirements are superseded
sourceOfTruth.deviceScope: iPhone mobile only. iPad design is explicitly excluded from ongoing work and final acceptance criteria
sourceOfTruth.referencePolicy: Original screenshots remain untouched; current product screens may be replaced or extended

baseline.prototypeIssue: Each prototype frame currently has one whole-frame transition; many flows are artificial loops rather than control-level interactions
baseline.countConflictResolved: Live Figma inventory is authoritative: 207 = 165 iPhone + 42 iPad

agreedProductChanges: Useful Today workspace
Consistent iPhone tab bar information architecture
Context-aware system plus action
Client 360 workspace and activity timeline
Global search
Complete calendar, messages, tasks, payments, documents, profile and help flows
Structured meeting-summary templates with context, result and actionable next steps
Semantic field accessories; chevron only for navigation
Replace oversized colored banners with status, toast, inline feedback, alerts and sheets
Universal non-medical CRM terminology
Today is the primary working dashboard; remove greeting, foreground the meeting count, use a compact week calendar and useful schedule interactions
Today requires at least seven useful states: schedule, list, empty day, upcoming meeting, in-progress meeting, schedule conflict and completed day with pending summaries
Client names use surname, first name, patronymic across all client-facing contexts

Use compact client display names as Surname I. O. across lists, cards, messages, calendar, tasks, payments and navigation headers; keep full surname, first name and patronymic only in the client profile and structured create/edit fields
Primary form actions use one stable sticky bottom action area across default, disabled and loading states
Vertical ellipsis is reserved for additional actions; field accessories remain semantic
Account directories live under More > Settings > Directories, including locations, services, meeting types, summary templates, payment methods and reminder defaults
Every directory requires visible states for list, search, empty, no results, selection, add, edit, delete confirmation, load error and save success
Run a full iOS 26 consistency audit across every iPhone screen and replace web-like banners, cards, actions and navigation patterns
Use iOS 26 Liquid Glass only for the floating navigation/control layer; keep CRM content on standard materials, never stack glass on glass, and tint only key actions or selection

Use only license-safe product assets: Inter under SIL OFL plus original editable vectors and locally created UI; replace every proprietary font, icon, image or component with a visually compatible open or original alternative
Do not create, redesign or include iPad screens in the current scope

auditFindings.prototype: Prototype screens use frame-level reactions with zero child-control reactions; this is a slideshow, not a real interactive model.
auditFindings.fields: Select and navigation semantics collapse into the same chevron; date/time and selection destinations are incomplete.
auditFindings.status: Legacy status family is visually unstable and unused by product screens; replace with a new feedback taxonomy.
auditFindings.shell: iPhone and iPad navigation labels and section counts conflict; replace with Today, Calendar, Clients, Messages, More.
auditFindings.ios26: The updated goal explicitly sets iOS 26 for current-generation iPhone only. Older iOS 27 and all iPad/iPadOS requirements are superseded. Apple's official iOS and iPadOS 26 Figma library was found under library key lk-a5b98decf0fb24381005421a2986b813149fcf20f37a1169316d44e2802c483494c6fc98ab8e083540a73bd5e45cf892a38123ee61981aee097d5f4eb8487a17; only its iPhone components are in scope. Confirmed assets include Tab Bar - iPhone, Status bar - iPhone, Sheet - Full Screen - iPhone, Sheet - Inspector - iPhone, Action Sheet, Button - Liquid Glass - Text/Symbol and Toolbar - Bottom - iPhone. Existing local wrappers remain the fallback where a direct library instance cannot preserve the CRM prototype.
auditFindings.keyboards: Visible gray letter-row placeholders were replaced with reusable system-like Russian keyboard components. Twelve iPhone states and one full-width iPad state were personally screenshot-checked. Two previously indexed frames were confirmed to be Ready to save states with hidden legacy layers, not keyboard-open states.
auditFindings.errorStates: All 34 named error and failure screens were personally screenshot-reviewed. Field validation, blocking alerts, message-level failures and declined payments need distinct patterns; page-load errors require the new contextual component. iPad Files, Payments, Tasks, Notifications, Calendar and Help contain detached actions or web-like feedback.
auditFindings.navigation: Tab bar is required only on root destinations and must be hidden on pushed detail, edit, creation, payment confirmation and modal screens. Some current screens have missing or incorrect active destinations; the iPhone Payments error screen currently highlights Clients.
auditFindings.iosConsistency: Several iPhone screens use web-dashboard patterns: black toast banners, detached green success strips, oversized outlined cards and competing full-width actions. These require a full screen-by-screen iOS 26 consistency pass.
auditFindings.formActions: Primary form buttons are vertically inconsistent across equivalent screens. Standardize a sticky bottom action area that preserves position across default, disabled and loading states.
auditFindings.directories: More > Settings > Directories is now a complete iPhone information architecture for locations, services, meeting types, structured summary templates, payment methods and reminder defaults. Locations include list, search/no-results, add, edit, delete confirmation, deleted, empty, load-error and saved states. The other five directories each include a practical list, an illustrative add form and a visibly changed saved state. All 26 settings and directory destinations were audited after wiring; every available Back, Add, Save, Retry, Delete, Cancel and search escape control has an explicit top-level destination.
auditFindings.today: Seven iPhone Today states now exist, were individually screenshot-checked after wiring, and use control-level reactions only. Whole-frame reaction count is zero on all seven screens. Add, view switch, day selection, meeting detail, conflict resolution and structured-summary destinations were verified.
auditFindings.calendar: The iPhone calendar root has a compact week strip, consistent segments, denser meeting cards and surname-first full names. Picker accessories now use a single down chevron. Create, validation, loading, edit and updated-success screens were visually checked. Meeting detail, updated-success and cancel-confirmation now share calm iOS inset-grouped content with vertical label/value hierarchy and a compact status capsule. The cancel state keeps the real meeting screen beneath a modal scrim, removes the stray chevron and uses unambiguous actions. An in-person create-meeting variant now conditionally reveals Location, keeps the primary CTA fixed, and has a verified control-level flow through list, selected state and Done back to the form. Service, format and client fields now have visually verified selection flows and updated-form return paths. Client selection uses surname-first full names, a dedicated focused-search surface, explicit results and no-results states, a direct create-client escape path, and concrete row/navigation/keyboard touch targets. The top-level client-create prototype follows Фамилия → Имя → Отчество → Телефон → Email and was personally screenshot-checked. Date selection now has current and changed calendar-sheet states, quick dates, explicit day selection, cancel and Done return paths. Time selection now has current and changed wheel states, start/end summary, duration presets, cancel and Done return paths. The time field uses a clock instead of the misleading calendar symbol throughout this flow. Calendar filters now have default, specialist-only, location-only and combined selection states plus three visibly filtered results. Back, Done, toggles, active filter, Reset, add and event-card actions are attached to concrete controls; all eight screen roots remain reaction-free and were individually screenshot-checked. A 12px navigation-header width defect found during visual QA was fixed on all three affected filter states.
auditFindings.calendarViews: Day, Week, Month and List are separate top-level iPhone calendar screens. Each was personally rendered and inspected after wiring. Segment switching, filter, add, meeting-card navigation and selected-date drill-down are attached only to concrete controls; all four roots remain reaction-free.
auditFindings.calendarMeetingFlow: Top-level iPhone states now exist for create validation, create saving, edit, created success, updated success, cancel confirmation, cancelled result, event creation, out-of-office, the vertical-ellipsis actions sheet, reminder default, reminder sent and contextual reminder network error. Every new state was individually rendered; reminder default and error were re-rendered singly after unreliable batch previews. A double calendar-plus-clock defect found only in the validation screenshot was fixed and re-rendered. The active detail exposes additional actions through a 44pt vertical ellipsis and a system bottom sheet. Reminder entry points from detail, created success, updated success and the actions sheet are wired to the contextual reminder flow; send, return and retry paths are attached to concrete controls. Cancellation uses concrete alert hit areas for Keep and Confirm, then lands on a contextual cancelled state with compact status, client-notified copy and a fixed return-to-calendar action. Event title and description focused-keyboard states are wired and individually screenshot-checked. Event now has context-preserving date, time and location sequences: calendar current/changed, time current/changed, cabinet/sphere selection and updated forms were each separately rendered and inspected. Reopening date and time after selecting Sphere now preserves the location across 18/15 August and 17:30/16:00 branches; nine new iPhone states were individually rendered and control-wired. Six additional focused-keyboard screens preserve each alternate date/time/location combination while editing title or description; every screen was individually rendered before control wiring. A duplicated visible time-wheel layer was discovered only in screenshot QA, removed, replaced with a transparent 50pt hit area and re-rendered. Out-of-office comment editing plus notify-client Yes/No sheet and selected No state are wired and individually screenshot-checked. Out-of-office period selection now has current-range, next-week and updated-form states; the range is visible directly on the calendar grid, quick selection is highlighted, the full path is control-wired, and all three screens were personally rendered and inspected. Context-preserving location returns now exist for all three alternate Event date/time combinations: six picker screens and the three return forms were each personally rendered after wiring. The Edit meeting service picker now has current and changed selections, in-bounds 44+ pt Back/Done targets, explicit commit/cancel behavior and a changed form; all four affected screens were personally rendered after wiring. Edit format now supports Online/In person with explicit commit/cancel behavior; choosing In person conditionally reveals Location and has cabinet/Sphere picker returns. All six new format/location screens were personally rendered after wiring. Edit client, date and time returns are complete with explicit commit/cancel behavior, context-preserving changed forms and separate visual verification. Reminder now has both-on, SMS-off, Email-off and both-off states. Whole 72pt channel rows toggle between states, explanatory copy follows the active channels, and the send action is visibly disabled when no channel is selected; all four states were personally rendered after wiring. The bounded cross-combination audit confirmed separate, visually verified commit/cancel paths for every edit field. Static prototype coverage intentionally demonstrates canonical single-field and conditional location paths instead of enumerating the mathematical cross-product of all simultaneous draft combinations; production state persistence remains a shared form-model behavior. Calendar implementation is closed for this pass and Client 360 is next.
auditFindings.client360: The three legacy client screens were individually rendered and rejected as the product baseline: they use obsolete four-tab navigation, fictional non-Russian names, medical terminology, English residue, clipped values, web-table rows and inconsistent actions. The new iOS 26 iPhone Clients root uses the unified five-tab shell with Clients selected, surname-first full names with patronymics, useful attention counts, filters, semantic client cards, focused search/no-results and empty-first-client states. Search, create-client escape paths, add controls and client-card entry are control-wired. Client 360 overview and activity are pushed screens without the root tab bar and include quick actions, an overview/activity switch and a vertical-ellipsis additional-actions sheet. Edit uses the surname-first filled form and returns to a compact saved confirmation. Archive and delete have distinct system alerts, cancel paths and result lists; archive also provides Undo. Contacts/data, meetings/tasks and messages/files are separate pushed subhubs with useful metrics, grouped rows and quick actions. Every affected screen was individually rendered after wiring. Screenshot-only QA caught and fixed title/subtitle collisions on list states and unwanted white container bands on the meetings/tasks metrics and quick actions. Cross-module destinations already available (meeting create/detail, message composer and document list) are wired; task creation/detail, file upload, document detail and invoice/payment destinations remain intentionally pending until their shared modules are redesigned in the next plan step.
auditFindings.tasks: The legacy task inventory was reviewed as a functional source but rejected as the visual baseline because it mixes nested prototype groups, obsolete spacing, name-order violations, ambiguous field chevrons and inconsistent action placement. A new top-level iOS 26 iPhone task root lives under the unified More-selected tab shell and shows active/overdue counts, All/Mine/Completed filters, date grouping, surname-first full-patronymic client context and explicit status/priority. Empty, loading and contextual network-error roots are separate control-wired screens; retry goes to loading and the empty CTA opens task creation. Mine and Completed filters show visibly distinct results, with native-style green completion checks. New-task forms exist for general and Client 360 entry contexts; selection fields use down accessories, due date uses a calendar accessory and the primary CTA is fixed at the shared bottom level. The general form has visually verified client, quick-due, priority, assignee and reminder pickers; changed priority, due, assignee and reminder values return to dedicated preserved forms. A custom date-and-time calendar sheet and a separate no-due form complete the canonical due-date branch. Title editing has a real Russian iPhone keyboard state and Done return. Alternate client selection now preserves Смирнов Алексей Викторович through form, created and completed states. Edit, update-success, preset/custom reschedule, no-due and duplicate/create/complete branches are control-wired and individually rendered. Screenshot QA caught and fixed the Smirnov completion title mutation, date-sheet bleed-through and two separate duplicate-title overlap defects. General and client-specific active, created and completed details preserve their own back destinations. Completion, reopening, additional actions, delete confirmation and the updated post-delete list are control-wired. Full client-context picker/action-sheet duplication remains pending before Tasks can be closed.
auditFindings.licensing: The product baseline uses Inter under the SIL Open Font License and original editable Simple CRM vectors. Proprietary Apple fonts, SF Symbols, remote library instances and licensed stock imagery are prohibited in deliverable product screens and must be replaced whenever found with open-license or original visually compatible alternatives. The latest full-page audit found Inter as the only font family across 14,491 styled text segments and all ten local text styles, zero remote components, no SF Symbol or SF Pro node names, and zero raster/video fills on top-level Prototype screens. Raster fills remaining elsewhere are isolated UX research/reference evidence and are not product assets.

The root uses the unified five-tab shell with Messages selected, searchable surname-first client conversations, unread filters and a clear create action. Recipient selection is a pushed screen without the tab bar and offers recent clients plus a direct create-client escape path. auditFindings.taskSharedReminderAllContexts2026: The existing compact task reminder sheet now covers all forty-eight task forms instead of the previous partial twenty-seven-field route set. auditFindings.payments2026: The iPhone payment flow was rebuilt as twenty-one control-wired screens: hub, empty/loading/error, amount and validation, three explicit payment methods, three review states, processing, three success states, decline/retry, history, invoice, sent confirmation and receipt.
